item.subject: maths
item.stem: The diagram shows a net of a cuboid with edges $8$ cm, $5$ cm and $4$ cm. An ant crawls on the surface from corner $A$ to opposite corner $G$.

parts.text: Which claim correctly identifies a shortest surface path?

options.text: On the net that joins faces into a $5$-by-$12$ rectangle, the straight $A$-to-$G$ segment has length $13$ cm, shortest among the three standard unfolds.
The shortest surface path is $\sqrt{8^{2}+5^{2}+4^{2}}=\sqrt{105}$ cm, the interior space diagonal.
Adding $8+5+4=17$ cm gives the shortest surface path.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice that compares unfold lengths.
